goal.answer: Implement rs-shell-core: the typed event types, in-process broadcast EventBus, length-prefixed JSON Unix-socket IPC protocol, and XDG-compliant runtime socket paths that every other crate depends on.

payload.plain: Implement rs-shell-core: the typed event types, in-process broadcast EventBus, length-prefixed JSON Unix-socket IPC protocol, and XDG-compliant runtime socket paths that every other crate depends on.

criteria.answer:
`ShellEvent` and all nested payload types compile and derive `Serialize`/`Deserialize`; verified by `cargo check -p rs-shell-core`.
`EventBus` supports `publish`, `subscribe`, and `subscribe_filtered` as a `Stream`; covered by passing unit tests.
Unix socket IPC uses a length-prefixed JSON frame over `tokio::net::UnixStream` and round-trips correctly; covered by a passing unit test.
Runtime socket paths follow Wayland/XDG conventions (`$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR` with fallback to `/run/user/<uid>/`) so they coexist alongside tools like `wl-clipboard`; path format verified by unit tests.
All public types carry doc comments and the crate passes `cargo clippy -p rs-shell-core -- -D warnings`.
Full verification: `cargo test -p rs-shell-core` and `cargo clippy -p rs-shell-core -- -D warnings` both pass.

phaseSnapshots.name: Implement Core IPC & Event Bus
phaseSnapshots.goal: Deliver a complete, tested rs-shell-core crate that other crates can depend on for events, bus, IPC, and socket paths.
phaseSnapshots.description: Create events.rs, bus.rs, ipc.rs, paths.rs, and lib.rs for rs-shell-core. Define all ShellEvent variants and payloads, implement EventBus on tokio::sync::broadcast, implement length-prefixed JSON IPC framing, implement XDG-compliant socket paths, and add unit tests for serialization, round-trip IPC, filtered subscriptions, and path resolution.

steps.description: Define all event payload types in events.rs with serde derives.
Implement EventBus with publish, subscribe, and subscribe_filtered.
Implement IPC message enums and send_message/recv_message framing.
Implement XDG runtime socket paths in paths.rs.
Add lib.rs re-exports and doc comments on public types.

verification.command: cargo test -p rs-shell-core && cargo clippy -p rs-shell-core -- -D warnings

assumptions.answer: Subplan 00 (Scaffold) is complete and `cargo build --workspace` already passes.; The user wants to implement Subplan 01 (Core IPC & Event Bus) first, before Subplan 02 (Config).; Dependencies listed in the root Cargo.toml (tokio, serde, serde_json, futures, tokio-stream, anyhow, thiserror, tracing, chrono, bytes, uuid) are acceptable to use.; Unit tests can use temp directories and temp Unix sockets; no live Wayland session is required.; Event type schema from implementation-plan.md Section 4.1 is the source of truth.
